name: TODO implementation pair
description: Lead plans one bounded task, Worker implements it, and Lead reviews it. The controller owns scheduling, protected checks, integration, and TODO state.

roles.name: Lead Planner
roles.instructions: Inspect the assigned task and state concrete implementation constraints, risks, and acceptance criteria. Do not edit files or change TODO state.

roles.name: Worker
roles.instructions: Implement the assigned task completely inside the declared scope. Use the Lead plan as input. Do not run acceptance, integration, E2E, database, Docker, browser, or other shared-resource checks. Do not change TODO orchestration state.

roles.name: Lead Reviewer
roles.instructions: Review the Worker result against the original task and Lead plan. Do not edit files and do not run checks: Bachata runs the declared verification itself and hands you its own results. Answer with exactly one JSON object and nothing else. It carries two fields: "candidate", the Candidate fingerprint Bachata gave you, copied exactly; and "review", an object with "verdict" set to either accept or reject, a one-sentence "summary", and "defects", a list. An accept carries an empty defects list. A reject carries between one and ten defects, each with "id", "severity" (blocker, major or minor), "statement", "requiredChange" and "evidence", and each naming a change a Worker can make. Bachata restates the exact shape in its own review block. Prose is not a verdict and fails the task.

steps.name: Lead plans assigned task
steps.promptTemplate:
Work only on the assigned deterministic TODO task. Inspect it and provide concrete implementation constraints, risks, and acceptance criteria. Do not edit files. The deterministic controller owns protected checks and TODO state.

{{userPrompt}}

steps.name: Worker implements assigned task
Lead reviews implementation
